sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Indian Lake State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: South Shore modern campground (where the pin is), 2027 on the booking site (same on 2027-05-18, 06-15 and 09-21): 20/30-amp sites $34 (87 sites), 50-amp sites $39 (58). The DNR's 2026 table: modern $32 / $37, semi-modern $27 / $32 while the toilet/shower building is closed (outside May 15 - Oct 14); the booking site charged $27 / $32 on 2026-10-27. West Shore semi-modern campground (20-amp, vault toilets): $27 in the 2026 table, $29 on the booking site for 2027. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails per fee schedule (South: $34 for the 20/30-amp sites, $39 for the 50-amp sites on 2027-05-18 / 2027-06-15 / 2027-09-21, $27 / $32 on 2026-10-27; West Shore Unit $29 / $27) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (South Unit - Campground $37 / $32 modern, $32 / $27 semi-modern; West Shore Campground semi-modern $27) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/indianlake ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/indianlake (South Modern Campground: 'There is 20/30-amp electrical service available on each site, along with some 50-amp sites'; West Semi-Modern: '20-amp electrical service is available at each site') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (South: 58 sites 20/30/50 A, 87 sites 20/30 A; West Shore: 72 sites 20 A; every site 'Electric and Water Hookups=Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup=No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The pin is on the South Shore modern campground (145 sites, CR 442 south of the lake): many sites with views of the lake, generally open but ringed by trees; equipment to 50 ft. The West Shore semi-modern campground, 4 miles northwest on County Road 455 across the lake, has 72 wooded sites with 20-amp electric only and equipment to 40 ft.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/indianlake (South Modern: 'Number of sites: 145', 'a variety of sites including accessible, pull-through and tent-only sites', 'Many sites feature waterfront views of the lake'; West Semi-Modern: 'Number of sites: 72', '4 miles northwest of the park on County Road 455') + midnrreservations.com allowed equipment (South to 50 ft, West Shore Unit to 40 ft), read 2026-10-22

values.note: South Shore: toilet & shower building, vault toilets, store, two-lane sanitation station with potable water near the contact station. West Shore: vault toilets, drinking fountains and jug fillers only; its campers may shower at the modern campground for $5.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/indianlake (South Modern amenities 'Concession or store', 'Modern campground', 'Sanitation station', 'Toilet & shower building', 'Vault toilet'; 'The park's sanitation station is located near the contact station, before the modern campground entrance. There is potable water available and two lanes'; West: 'restrooms are limited to vault toilets with drinking fountains and jug fillers', '$5 per shower'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: South Shore modern campground: reserve online or at 800-447-2757. West Shore semi-modern campground (typically mid-June through Labor Day): first-come, first-served with self-registration at the west shore contact station or the modern campground office ('local sale only' in the DNR table).

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/indianlake ('Indian Lake South Modern Campground: For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online'; West: 'campsites are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Self-registration is available at the west shore unit contact station') + DNR rates table (West Shore Campground: 'This loop is local sale only'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Pin sits on the South Shore modern campground (park address 8970 W CR 442). DNR page + booking site: 145 sites, 20/30 A everywhere and 50 A at 58, electric only, equipment to 50 ft, pull-throughs, shower building, vault toilets, store, sanitation station; reservable online/phone. The West Shore campground differs: 72 semi-modern sites, 20 A only, vault toilets, FCFS self-registration, $27 (2026) / $29 (2027), Jun 7 - Sep 3. Fees 27-37 -> 34-39 (South, 2027 booking site; 2026 and West Shore in the note), Recreation Passport in fees.note. --AWH note kept unchanged.
flags: Missing operator website and phone: the entry links only the bare reservation home page (https://midnrreservations.com/) and has no phone. The park's DNR page is https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/indianlake; park phone 906-341-2355 (reservations 800-447-2757).
